character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A single monster for a turn-based JRPG battle, full body, centered. Cute and warm Ghibli-like creature design, readable chunky silhouette, thick dark outline. No background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no extra characters, no weapons other than those described. A short, round little skeleton night-watchman. Cream and warm light-brown bones, a big round skull with small warm orange lights glowing inside the eye sockets, a tattered triangular grey-brown hooded cloak over the shoulders, an old brass lantern held in one bony hand at its side, short bony arms and legs in a waddling stance. A diligent old guard, cute rather than scary. Palette: #D2BD9A, #A2927B, #6F4B33, #92552D. 2D pixel art, classic 32-bit era style (16/32-bit JRPG, SNES and PlayStation 1 look), crisp square pixels, limited palette, flat shading with hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, no 3D rendering.
